performance.verdict: Spend is live but the funnel is broken — 9 overdue milestones confirm it.

findings.text: 0 leads from $171.14 Meta spend (28d) and 342 clicks — CPL is undefined because the lead capture step does not exist yet.

9 SOW milestones overdue since 2026-07-31: stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages, reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and nurture sequences — all undelivered.
GBP actions dropped -40.91% (7d vs prior 7d); last 2 days show 0 GBP actions, down from a peak of 11 on 2026-08-28 — organic local visibility is declining.
Meta spend ramped from $0 to $12–$19/day since 2026-09-03 with 0 leads across all 13 spend days — flat/rising spend with zero results signals a broken funnel, not creative fatigue.
GA4 sessions exist (3,293 over 28d) but GA4 conversions = 0, confirming no conversion event is firing — tracking is not live, consistent with the overdue landing pages milestone.
